text:
mara: heads-up: opened emergency docs PR to patch wording and status link after last night's outage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502. Needs quick eyeballs + approval.

ben: looking now. which pages changed?

mara: serving/streaming.md, embeddings/limits.md, and a new short known-issues entry under /known-issues/outage-2026-03.md. Also updated the SDK snippet for python to show retry headers.

sue: quick note please correct the status URL it points to /incidents/742 (old). Should be /incidents/INC-742. I can push an edit.

doc-ci-bot: preview build queued #2310

ben: can you paste the python snippet here? want to confirm we don't leak auth examples.

mara: sure:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...", timeout=10, retry_headers={"x-retry-reason":"outage-hotfix-2026-03"})
print(resp.text)
```

sue: looks fine. drop the explicit api_key example, good. Also add note about Dedicated customers maybe seeing different rate-limit wording.

mara: updated to remove api_key example and added Dedicated note. Re-ran preview.

doc-ci-bot: preview build failed #2310  Error: Link check failed - https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-742 returned 500

infra-bot: FYI the status page had a transient 500 during snapshot; engineers are on it.

ben: that 500 will block the docs link checker; for hotfix we can: a) skip linkcheck on that single link (add to allowlist) b) temporarily point to the incident anchor on status homepage. Which do we prefer?

mara: prefer allowlist to avoid changing content. I can add a docs-ci exception entry and re-run.

yakov: be careful with the allowlist. We should also add an internal note in the PR description about the temp CI override so reviewers know why linkcheck was skipped.

mara: done - added CI allowlist entry in .docsci/ignore-links.txt and added PR note. Re-triggering preview build.

doc-ci-bot: preview build succeeded #2311  preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4502

ben: LGTM for content. Two approvals from docs owners required. @sue one more from you?

sue: quick scan ok. Approved.

mara: Thanks. Ops has a deploy freeze until 09:15 UTC for infra maintenance. This is an emergency hotfix but confirm if we merge now do we need an ops blessing?

oncall: ops here  we are mid-maintenance window. If this is just docs text and not config, we can merge but hold the live deploy until the maintenance window lifts. If you need it live now because the status link is used in incident comms, we can waive the freeze after a quick SRE signoff.

mara: status link included for incident cross-reference; live deploy would be helpful. Can SRE sign off?

oncall: SRE approves immediate deploy for docs-only hotfix. Will monitor 10m after deploy for errors.

mara: merging PR and kicking off backport to branch live-docs.

doc-ci-bot: merge completed  PR merged by mara  backport job queued

doc-ci-bot: backport succeeded  branch: live-docs  job #89

infra-bot: starting docs live deploy job 992. Monitoring endpoints for 429/500.

oncall: watching. If token-bucket symptoms appear, we will revert.

doc-ci-bot: live deploy succeeded  job 992  docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/known-issues/outage-2026-03

ben: verified the page, status link resolves, SDK snippet looks sanitized.

sue: added a short changelog entry under /changelog/2026-03-21.md noting the hotfix and the CI allowlist.

mara: filed a follow-up issue to add a linkcheck retry + status-page fallback in the CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/108

oncall: all good. closing watch in 15m. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
